Massachusetts

SE Massachusetts —
Bristol & Plymouth County

Eight active markets across the two most active counties in SE Massachusetts. From urban Fall River to suburban Mansfield to coastal Dartmouth and Westport.

MA
Fall River
ResidentialMulti-FamilyREO

My home market and the one I know best. Fall River spans a wide range of price points — from first-time buyer starter homes to waterfront and colonial estates. Strong buyer demand, active REO pipeline, and a market I've worked consistently across all price tiers.

Search active listings →
MA
Dartmouth
LuxuryWaterfrontResidential

One of the most desirable markets in Bristol County — waterfront properties, horse farms, and high-end residential. Dartmouth attracts serious buyers and demands a listing strategy that matches the caliber of the homes. I hold KW Luxury certification for a reason.

Search active listings →
MA
Westport
LuxuryWaterfrontLand

Westport is land, privacy, and water. Buyers come here for coastal access, large lots, and properties that can't be found anywhere else in the region. It's a nuanced market that rewards agents who actually know it — price per acre, riparian rights, and all.

Search active listings →
MA
New Bedford
ResidentialMulti-FamilyInvestment

A high-volume residential and investment market with strong multi-family activity. New Bedford buyers tend to move fast when the price is right. I've closed in multiple neighborhoods here across a range of buyer profiles — from owner-occupants to investors.

Search active listings →
MA
Swansea
ResidentialSuburban

A suburban market between Fall River and Providence that attracts buyers who want more space without leaving the corridor. Consistent demand, solid school districts, and a market that tends to move quickly on well-priced listings.

Search active listings →
MA
Taunton
ResidentialMulti-Family

Bristol County's commercial hub and a strong residential market in its own right. Taunton offers buyers more square footage at competitive price points, with good highway access that makes it an attractive alternative to higher-priced suburban markets.

Search active listings →
MA
Attleboro
ResidentialCommuterSuburban

A commuter-friendly market on the Providence-Boston corridor. Attleboro draws buyers who need MBTA access and want more home for their money than closer-in markets offer. Competitive at every price point and consistently active year-round.

Search active listings →
MA
Mansfield
ResidentialSuburbanCommuter

One of the most sought-after suburban markets in the region — top-rated schools, easy highway and commuter rail access, and a residential market that stays active even when others slow. Buyers compete here; listings move fast when they're priced right.

Search active listings →
Rhode Island

Rhode Island —
East Bay & Aquidneck Island

Six markets across Bristol and Newport County RI — from the village feel of Warren to the luxury coastal enclaves of Little Compton and Portsmouth.

RI
Bristol
LuxuryWaterfrontHistoric

One of Rhode Island's most distinctive markets — waterfront access on Narragansett Bay, beautifully preserved historic homes, and a tight inventory that keeps values strong. Bristol buyers are serious. If you're selling here, you need positioning that matches the market.

Search active listings →
RI
Tiverton
LuxuryWaterfrontRural

Tiverton offers privacy, water views, and an unhurried pace that attracts buyers who know exactly what they want. It's a market where relationships matter — knowing which properties are coming before they list makes a real difference here.

Search active listings →
RI
Warren
ResidentialWaterfrontVillage

A charming East Bay market with strong walkability, water access, and a growing demand from buyers relocating from Providence and Greater Boston. Warren punches above its size — it's a market worth paying attention to.

Search active listings →
RI
Barrington
LuxurySuburbanTop Schools

Barrington is Rhode Island's premier suburban market — consistently ranked among the top school districts in the state, waterfront and near-water properties, and a buyer pool that's both sophisticated and serious. Listings here require a premium marketing approach.

Search active listings →
RI
Portsmouth
LuxuryWaterfrontEquestrian

Portsmouth spans Aquidneck Island's rural northern end — waterfront estates, equestrian properties, and land that doesn't come available often. When it does, it moves on relationships. This is a market where being known matters more than having the right search filter.

Search active listings →
RI
Little Compton
LuxuryRuralCoastal

Rhode Island's most exclusive rural coastal market. Little Compton properties rarely appear on Zillow — they move through networks. If you're buying or selling here, you need an agent with the right relationships. I've been in this market long enough to have them.
